linux-x86_64.provenance: Carried from the recorded upstream base and verified as a complete compiler bootstrap in M1.

linux-aarch64.provenance: Carried from the recorded upstream base and verified as a complete compiler bootstrap in M1.

darwin-x86_64.provenance: Regenerated in M1 from the FreeBASIC-NG 1.20.0 compiler sources for the native Intel macOS host.

darwin-aarch64.provenance: Regenerated in M7 from the native Darwin ARM64 compiler to repair the Darwin cva_list ABI and preserve acosf constant evaluation; replaces a bootstrap with a Linux host identity.

generator.command: fbc src/compiler/*.bas -gen gcc -m fbc -i inc -r -target darwin-aarch64

win64.provenance: Carried from the recorded upstream base and verified as a complete compiler bootstrap in M1.

win32-aarch64.provenance: Regenerated in M1 from the FreeBASIC-NG 1.20.0 compiler sources for the native Windows ARM64 host; patched in M7 for ARM64 COFF object metadata.
